property_summary: For every call sending exactly 10 ether in a valid new timestamp, C pays out (draining address(c).balance to 0) exactly when block.number % 15 == 0 and otherwise keeps its balance at 20 ether; the mutant pays out on blocks with block.number % 7 == 0, so on any block divisible by 7 but not by 15 the buggy contract wrongly drains its balance.
change_summary: Change the payout condition from block.number % 15 to block.number % 7 so transfers occur on different blocks.
